how-a-village-kitchen-feeds-300-families.lead: Before the city wakes up, a small team is already turning donated ingredients into a daily ritual of care.
how-a-village-kitchen-feeds-300-families.quote: The kitchen is more than a place to eat. It is where neighbours remember they are not alone.

sections.title: Before sunrise
sections.description: Volunteers start cooking at 5am, chopping vegetables and stirring huge pots of dal for the day ahead.

sections.title: Hot meals for 300 families
sections.description: By noon, parents and children gather to share a warm meal, served with care every single day.

back-to-school-supplies-update.lead: A school bag can be a small thing, but for a child starting the year it can carry confidence, possibility and a fresh beginning.
back-to-school-supplies-update.quote: When every child has the tools to learn, the whole classroom moves forward.

sections.title: Packed and ready
sections.description: Bags, books and uniforms are sorted by size so every child gets exactly what fits.

sections.title: A confident first day
sections.description: Children walk into class with new supplies and the confidence to start the year strong.

volunteer-spotlight.lead: Anil did not set out to become a long-term volunteer. He simply kept showing up, one Saturday at a time.
volunteer-spotlight.quote: You do not need to change everything. You only need to keep making one useful difference.

sections.title: One Saturday became three years
sections.description: Anil showed up once and kept coming back, giving every weekend to the cause.

sections.title: A crew that keeps growing
sections.description: His example brought friends and neighbours along, and the weekend team grows every month.

where-your-donation-goes.lead: Trust is built in the details, so this year we followed every contribution from the first transaction to the final delivery.
where-your-donation-goes.quote: Transparency is not a report we publish once a year. It is a promise we keep every day.

sections.title: Every contribution tracked
sections.description: From the moment a donation arrives to the day help is delivered, we log where it goes.

sections.title: Open for everyone to see
sections.description: Our annual report breaks down each expense so supporters can see the impact of their gift.

mobile-health-clinic-reaches-remote-vill.lead: For families far from a hospital, the arrival of a clinic on wheels turns distance into a problem with a practical answer.
mobile-health-clinic-reaches-remote-vill.quote: The most important part of care is often simply making it possible to reach someone.

sections.title: A clinic on wheels
sections.description: The mobile clinic travels to villages hours away from the nearest hospital.

sections.title: Care at the doorstep
sections.description: Doctors offer check-ups, medicine and advice to families who had no access before.

winter-food-packs-for-families.lead: Before the cold season arrives, volunteers are planning routes, packing essentials and making sure support reaches every doorstep.
winter-food-packs-for-families.quote: A food pack is practical help, but it also says: your community sees you and is here for you.

sections.title: Packed with care
sections.description: Volunteers fill each box with dry rations and warm supplies before the cold arrives.

sections.title: On the way to 400 families
sections.description: Trucks are loaded and routes planned so every pack reaches its door in time.
